causal_diagnosis: The opening prompt told the Agent to use envbench_shell for installation, conflicting with the later optional hypothesis-tool instruction.
The tool required copying complete obligation objects even though the harness could bind exact obligations from subject names in the immediate pre-measurement.
The Agent encountered and executed many provider hypotheses, so non-activation cannot be attributed to absence of an applicable decision.
decision: Reject the v1 interface. Before any effect batch, remove the prompt conflict and replace copied obligation objects with target subject names that the harness binds to exact active obligations.
scientific_boundary: The retry is another consumed instrumentation qualification. It cannot estimate success or efficiency effect.
